The unnamed '''Harbinger Medical Officer''' served aboard the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|Harbinger]] in [[3951 BBY]]

==Biography==
{{Quote|We haven't had chance to fully examine it, sir - he looks human, but he's... fractured in several places.|The Harbinger's Chief Medical Officer speaking to The [[Harbinger Captain|Harbinger's Captain]] about the [[Darth Sion|Mysterious Medical Patient]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
She was another known member of the Crew aboard the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|Harbinger]] when [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Sion|Sion]] seized control of the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|Hammerhead Cruiser]]. It has been assumed that she was killed when Sion broke out of his [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] tank and said ''"I've come for the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi]]"''.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> A holo recording created by the [[Harbinger Captain|Captain]] contained a recording of Sion's apparent break out.

==Personality==
{{Quote|The strange thing is, I keep feeling like someone's watching us, here in the ship, but I can't see anyone. I don't like this.|The Harbinger's Chief Medical Officer becoming ever more paranoid|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
She seemed like somebody who was calm and collected in usual circumstances, however in the days leading to the attack on the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|Harbinger]] she grew very paranoid and suspected things weren't quite right. She noticed some crew members were not showing up for shifts and she increasingly felt like she was being watched.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
